summary: Web Push (VAPID + Service Worker) feature tested end-to-end. Backend: 41 tests pass (1 skipped due to external httpbin.org rate-limit, not a code bug). Frontend: staff toggle-push ON/OFF, test-push, and customer tracking subscribe flows fully verified via Playwright with mocked PushManager + XHR interception. Service worker is served at /service-worker.js with Content-Type application/javascript and contains push + notificationclick handlers. Full regression (auth, products, orders, SSE, ESC/POS, reports, Excel) still green.
critical_code_review_comments: _send_push cleanup branch only triggers on HTTP 404/410 from WebPushException. Other transient failures (e.g., 5xx, network) correctly leave the subscription intact — good. Consider also cleaning on 401/403 (gone keys) if observed in production logs.

Test fake keys (e.g., p256dh=kFAKE) cause pywebpush base64 decoding warnings (`Invalid base64-encoded string`). Backend handles them gracefully via try/except; no crash. This is expected during testing.
server.py is 1157 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline. Consider modularising push helpers, routes, and SSE into separate files for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Test push_subscriptions documents created and cleaned up per-test. One TEST_ order created via /api/orders for customer-tracking flow (left in DB; non-destructive).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Push delivery itself cannot be verified in headless env — only the wiring (endpoint accepts subs, push_to_staff/push_to_order invoked on order events). Auto-cleanup test depends on httpbin.org/status/410 returning 410 (not 503 rate-limit) — skipped automatically when rate-limited. Frontend tests stub navigator.serviceWorker.register/getRegistration/ready + Notification.requestPermission to bypass real browser permissions. Use XHR interceptor (not fetch hook) because the app uses axios.
verified_features: GET /api/push/vapid-public-key returns 88-char base64url public key starting with 'B', no auth required
POST /api/push/subscribe stores doc in db.push_subscriptions for both staff and customer roles
Upsert on duplicate endpoint — only 1 record kept
POST /api/push/test requires staff auth (401 without token, 200 for admin & kasir)
Fake subscription with unreachable endpoint does not crash /api/orders create or /api/orders/{id}/status updates
Order status walk (pembayaran_diterima → diproses → dimasak → siap_diantar → selesai) succeeds with push_to_staff/push_to_order fire-and-forget
Service worker at /service-worker.js: HTTP 200, Content-Type application/javascript, contains 'push' event + 'notificationclick' handlers

Staff NotificationBell toggle-push: requests Notification permission, fetches VAPID key, calls pushManager.subscribe, POSTs {endpoint, keys, role:'staff', order_id:null}, sets localStorage swm_push_enabled=on, shows toast & test-push-button
toggle-push OFF posts /api/push/unsubscribe and clears localStorage
Customer /track/:orderId shows customer-push-prompt + customer-push-button for non-terminal orders; clicking subscribes with role='customer' and the orderId
